- `Search / Insert / Min / Max / Successor / Delete → O(h)`
- `h = Θ(lg n) → O(lg n)`　｜　`h = Θ(n) → O(n)`
- `T.root → O(1)`　｜　`lg n = log₂ n`
- `空树 + Sorted Keys 升序逐个 insert()（n 次）→ Θ(n²)（建树总时间）`　｜　`buildBalanced() → Θ(n)`
- 增长：`lg lg n < lg n < n < n lg n`
- [Q3 · Height](nodal://note/node-trees-heaps-q3/sec-height-index)
